title: FilteredComplexGradedHomology
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K^\bullet$ a cochain complex and $F$ a decreasing filtration of $K^\bullet$ by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Let $P$ be a bigraded complex with differential of bidegree $(0,1)$ and isomorphisms $e_{p,q}:P^{p,q}\cong (\operatorname{gr}^p_F K)^{p+q}$ intertwining the differentials. For each $p,q\in\mathbb Z$, set $B=F.\mathrm{complexBoundaries}(p,p+q,1)$ and $Z=F.\mathrm{complexCycles}(p,p+q,1)$, subobjects of $(\operatorname{gr}^p_F K)^{p+q}$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Then $B\le Z$ and $H(P)^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{coker}(B\hookrightarrow Z)$. This is a statement about one homology object, without a spectral-sequence existence assertion.

proof.text: Apply filteredComplex_firstPage_cycles_boundaries to identify the page-one cycle and boundary subobjects with the kernel and image of the graded differential. Square-zero gives image_le_kernel, hence the required containment.

For any short complex S in an abelian category, Mathlib homologyIsoCokernelLift identifies its homology with the cokernel of the kernel lift. The kernelSubobjectIso and cokernel.mapIso replace the kernel object by the kernel subobject. The incoming map factors through its image subobject by factorThruImageSubobject_comp_imageToKernel. Since factorThruImageSubobject is epic, cokernelEpiComp removes it. Thus homology is the cokernel of Subobject.ofLE from image to kernel. Apply this proved private helper to the graded short complex and rewrite by the first-page subobject equalities.

Use ShortComplex.isoMk with e at (p,q-1), (p,q), (p,q+1). The incoming commutativity is hd at q-1, rewriting (q-1)+1=q; the outgoing one is hd at q. Integer arithmetic identifies the resulting short complex with the graded short complex at n=p+q. P.homologyIsoSc' selects these adjacent indices, and ShortComplex.homologyMapIso transports this isomorphism through homology. Compose with the quotient isomorphism from the previous step.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_graded_homology
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K)
    (P : HomologicalComplex C (ComplexShape.up' (⟨0, 1⟩ : ℤ × ℤ)))
    (e : ∀ p q : ℤ, P.X (p, q) ≅ (F.gradedPiece p).X (p + q))
    (hd : ∀ p q : ℤ, P.d (p, q) (p, q + 1) ≫ (e p (q + 1)).hom =
      (e p q).hom ≫ (F.gradedPiece p).d (p + q) (p + (q + 1)))
    (p q : ℤ) :
    ∃ hBZ : F.complexBoundaries p (p + q) 1 ≤ F.complexCycles p (p + q) 1,
      Nonempty (P.homology (p, q) ≅ cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hBZ))
